title: Add cross-platform CI matrix running library tests per target
description: Native runners: ubuntu x86_64, ubuntu-24.04-arm, macos-14 (aarch64), macos-13 (x86_64), windows-latest (msvc); musl x86_64 and aarch64 via cross for AWS. Each target builds the library and runs unit tests + cargo test --test bdd; rustfmt and clippy -D warnings gate every push/PR. Done when: all targets are green.
right_now_summary: The cross-platform CI matrix still needs setup and green tests on every target.
